role: post-hoc development test of a differentiable source-region mixture-of-experts
decision_rule: Proceed only if the MoE lowers mean full-record L2 by at least 5% versus the frozen base and improves at least 9 of 16 historical records without gate collapse.
limits: The 16 evaluation records were opened earlier. This one-seed, one-model, 5 Hz experiment is a structural development diagnostic and cannot be reported as independent validation, localization evidence or calibrated UQ.
